STORY-000.title: Command Center
STORY-000.summary: Nine-tab Command Center: Overview, Outcomes, Users & Use Case, Guardrails, Systems, Project Management, AI Agents, Knowledge Base, Data Model. Single data source (assets/data.js), global sample/real toggle, honest grey live-status indicators, one-level drilldown modals on every card.
